title: maya-soc2-pocket-dailynote-2026-03-28
content:
Morning pocket notes — quick brain dump while triaging evidence and vendor check items. Mostly shorthand, action items, and things I need to remember to hand off.

Context
- Doing a fast pass on remaining AICPA control evidence for change management + key access. Team requested we close 8 artifacts by end of week.
- Follow-ups with vendors: VaultCorp (KMS integration), LogStream (retention proof), SAMLId (SAML metadata + prod test).

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Confirm KMS key rotation proof for Dedicated customers (VaultCorp).: ask Evan for the rotation schedule export (sysadmin CSV). Est 30m.
- [ ] Upload trimmed CloudTrail snippet showing cross-account access blocked (INF-1023). Est 45m.
- [ ] Draft short note for auditors about how we handle dev/prod secret separation (use example flows). Attach architecture diagram. Est 1h.
- [ ] Quick vendor attestation checklist: LogStream retention + SAMLId metadata + VaultCorp HSM cert. Ping vendors, request signed email. Est 20m.
- [ ] Add evidence file names to Confluence artifact index after upload. Make sure filenames include environment and date.

Loose items / questions
- How recent must the rotation log be? (auditor asked for last 6 months vs 90 days) — check audit playbook page.
- Do we have a signed BAAs for LogStream? I think so but need copy. Where did Legal store it? (Slack @legal or confluence contract vault?)
- SAML test: need test SP metadata from staging to reproduce assertion error. Samir to run one test and share assertion dump.

Notes to self (commands / quick refs)
- Vault rotation export: aws s3 cp s3://redwood-rotation-exports/vault-rotation.csv ~/downloads/ && head -n 50 vault-rotation.csv
- CloudTrail filter for cross-account denies: jq '.Records[] | select(.eventName=="AssumeRole" and .errorCode=="AccessDenied")' cloudtrail.json
- PR for infra evidence upload: link above — PR #412 has the script that zips artifacts into evidence-bundle.zip

Hand-off checklist (if I need to escalate or OOO)
- Who to hand off to: Evan (access/KMS), Samir (SAML tests), Legal for vendor docs.
- Slack msg template: "Hey @%s — quick request: could you share [artifact] for [vendor] by EOD? Auditors requested for SOC2 alpha. Thanks!"
- Where artifacts go: drive -> shared_drives/company/security-and-compliance/soc2/2026-Q1/evidence_uploads

Meeting notes snippet (sync 10:30)
- Evan: will pull rotation csv by 11:15 and drop in our evidence folder.
- Samir: will run SAML assertion test on staging; found token binding mismatch; will escalate to okta team if not resolved.
- Legal: requested a copy of LogStream BAA; Maya to find and attach.

Micro-reminders (very quick)
- Save a screenshot of the console page that shows "rotation scheduled" (timestamp + key-id).
- Rename files like: vault-rotation-2026-03-28-maya.csv
- Avoid putting PII in evidence screenshots; redact user ids.

Random brainstorming (for audit narrative)
- Short paragraph idea: "Rotation policy is enforced via VaultCorp automated rotations every X days. We surface rotation events in our audit log which is stored for 12 months and immutable. Dedicated customers are mapped to separate key aliases to ensure tenant separation." — flesh out with specific numbers after Evan confirms.

End-of-day checklist (tick before closing)
- [ ] All requested artifacts uploaded and filenames standardized.
- [ ] Confluence index updated + chat to auditors (one message).
- [ ] Quick retro note on what blocked progress (vendor delays / missing scripts).

If I'm OOO: leave this doc with next steps and tag @Evan for KMS export and @Samir for SAML failures.

---
Small log entries (append as I go):
- 09:08: pinged Legal for LogStream BAA (Slack thread #legal-contracts).
- 09:36: Evan acked — will drop rotation CSV by 11:10.
- 10:12: Samir found SAML mismatch; added JIRA INF-1028 to track.

End.
